name: Quixotic ExchangeV4 missing buyer authorization
summary: ExchangeV4.fillSellOrder validates only the seller signature, then pulls ERC-20 payment from the caller-supplied buyer without buyer authorization. The attacker signed sales of a fake ERC-1155 token and named allowance-holding wallets as buyers, draining OP and WETH.

loss.notes: Exact victim debits across 891 successful calls, including the 2.5% marketplace fee. No attacker input is subtracted from victims: payment comes directly from the named buyers. Later recovery, swaps and bridge transfers are excluded. Optimism WETH is valued at the contemporaneous Ethereum WETH quote (1:1 ETH units).

ageReset.description: Direct immutable ExchangeV4 runtime contains the missing buyer authorization; ordinary registry wiring and currency approval do not introduce that defect.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age history. eth_getTransactionReceipt and debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) for source-1 show a direct call to ExchangeV4 by 0x0a0805082ea0fc8bfdcc6218a986efda6704efe5 with a different buyer, 0xbaf40247e54584b109557bcfb71d7f3f2deeb26d. Receipt logs 1/2 debit that buyer 0.0025/0.0975 WETH for marketplace fee/seller payment. The fake NFT 0xbe81eabdbd437cba43e4c1c330c63022772c2520 was created by the attacker in 0x375751e30c59240b8afc70ec25bae8563fa9b5eacb6f33afcd7f702b1e674ae7, block 13583604; its transfer call supplies no genuine consideration. Source-5 validates the seller only and never authenticates the buyer. This authorization defect is in the direct ExchangeV4 runtime, not in its royalty, cancellation or payment registries. eth_getCode is empty at block 8996835; keccak256 matches the recorded hash at deployment block 8996836 and pre-exploit block 13583675. Source-4 receipt and transaction identify a top-level creation by the recorded creator. The verified runtime has no upgrade or destruction path. Etherscan V2 account.txlist for the marketplace, blocks 0..13650000 ascending with offset=10000 and continuation after blocks 10931859 and 12680403, returns 23569 transactions. The sole setRegistryContracts is 0x3f1bf56216d8810155e1d9d612d47981768287f9429d0a4d253582f776372e46 at block 8996915: it wires the same ordinary registry addresses used by the exploit trace, without changing buyer authorization. Initial wiring makes the exchange operational; no erroneous configuration value is necessary to the generic missing-authorization flaw, so deployment supplies the age. For earliest-use review, decode successful fillSellOrder selector 0x912d97fc: nonzero paymentERC20 (argument 8) and buyer (argument 10) different from sender identify 891 calls, all by the attacker, first source-1. Cross-check eth_getLogs SellOrderFilled(address,address,address,uint256,uint256), topic 0x70ba0d31158674eea8365d0f7b9ac70e552cc28b8bb848664e4feb939c6578f8, in ranges 8996836..11323418 and 11323419..13650000: 9320 and 8442 logs. Ten emitting transactions are absent from the direct-call inventory; callTracer of all ten finds no internally routed ERC-20 fill with a noncaller buyer. The related DutchAuctionFilled history has 43 events, all in the direct inventory; its two ERC-20 fills (blocks 10495328 and 10556523) have buyer equal to caller. The previous seed anchor, source-11, is a later campaign call 7503 seconds after source-1.

Verified ExchangeV4 flattened Solidity at https://optimistic.etherscan.io/address/0x065e8a87b8f11aed6facf9447abe5e8c5d7502b6#code; reproduce Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode, chainid=10. Compiler v0.8.9+commit.e5eed63a, optimizer 10000 runs. SHA-256 of returned SourceCode UTF-8 (original CRLF): 2bc43ea62d3a28bcfe958507c8cab21437afd15020256704eee53576b6a4ca4f. Inspect fillSellOrder, _checkValidERC20Payment and _sendERC20PaymentsWithRoyalties: seller-only signature validation followed by safeTransferFrom(buyer,...).

Reviewed complete gross campaign loss. Reproduce eth_getLogs on the marketplace for SellOrderFilled, blocks 13583676..13596578, with indexed seller 0x0a0805082ea0fc8bfdcc6218a986efda6704efe5 and indexed NFT 0xbe81eabdbd437cba43e4c1c330c63022772c2520. There are 891 successful transactions through source-9 (block 13595655, transaction 0, timestamp 1656656369), naming 869 distinct buyers. For each transaction, decode fillSellOrder paymentERC20 (argument 8), buyer (argument 10) and price (argument 5), then sum that token's receipt Transfer logs whose from is the buyer. Every sum equals the calldata price, with no mismatches. Totals: 688 OP calls debit 219187587757905560549838 base units, split 213707898063957921536313 to the attacker and 5479689693947639013525 to fee recipient 0xec1557a67d4980c948cd473075293204f4d280fd; 203 WETH calls debit 23779784968469091621, split 23185290344257364353 to the attacker and 594494624211727268 to the fee recipient. Historical decimals() at block 13583675 is 18 for both assets. Both transfers are unauthorized victim depletion; the fee is not deducted from gross loss. Source-10 pauses the exchange at block 13596578. Paused/Unpaused event scans from deployment through block 157503675 find that one pause and no unpause; owner renounces in 0xdd934d4395a51ffde70c2d28b39b2366ad7d01148eca013973a41589ee45c742 at block 13967330. Etherscan txlist blocks 13650001..157503675 returns 47 transactions, including 21 reverted sell fills and no successful fills. Price snapshots source-7/source-8 value the measured tokens at the first-exercise time; subsequent attacker disposals do not set this liquid-asset valuation.
